hard_boundaries: The 11-Nov-2020 RICPE event and 30-Nov-2021 San Telmo event are separate evidential objects.
A&G Asesores and A&G Capital Investment Partners are not to be treated as the same legal person.
A professional relationship is not proof of knowledge, conflict, coordination, breach or crime.
No direct Borja–Guerra professional relationship is currently established.
The unnamed Lanzarote complex in the 2021 event is not to be labelled Sun Park without source closure.
RSM's later 2024 integration of San Telmo does not create retrospective responsibility for earlier conduct.
